summary: Reverse a conditional probability using the two individual probabilities.
template: Given P(A)={p}, P(B)={q}, P(A|B)={r}, find P(B|A).

summary: Two balls drawn without replacement from a bag of red and blue balls; give the distribution of the number of red balls.
template: Draw {k} balls without replacement from {r} red and {b} blue; find distribution of red count.

summary: Add the order and degree of a second-order differential equation in which derivative terms are raised to powers.
template: Find order + degree of the differential equation {equation}.

summary: Recover F from its derivative sec^4x/cosec^4x and a value at pi/4. OR integrate (log x - 3)/(log x)^4.
template: Given F'(x) = {expr} and F({a}) = {b}, find F(x).

summary: Find the unknown coordinate of a point whose perpendicular distance from a given plane equals 2 root 2.
template: Find {lambda} so that the point {P(lambda)} is {d} units from plane {plane}.

summary: Find the unknown component so that a + b is perpendicular to a - b.
template: Given a = {a(y)}, b = {b}, find y so that (a+b) is perpendicular to (a-b).

summary: Integrate 1 over the sum of square root and cube root of x. OR definite integral of cos x over (1+sin x)(4+sin x).
template: Find the integral of 1/(x^{1/m} + x^{1/n}) dx.

summary: Find where a given line meets the plane through three axis-intercept points.
template: Find where line {line} meets the plane through {A}, {B}, {C}.

summary: Using two cross-product relations among four vectors, show two combinations are parallel. OR unit vectors along diagonals and area of a parallelogram.
template: Given {cross relations}, prove {vector1} is parallel to {vector2}.

summary: A card is lost from a deck; two cards then drawn are both aces. Find the probability the lost card was an ace.
template: One card lost from {deck}; {n} drawn are all {kind}; find P(lost card was {kind}).

summary: Evaluate the integral from 0 to pi of x over (1 + sin x).
template: Evaluate integral 0..{a} of x f(x) dx where f(a-x) = f(x).

summary: Area between y = x^3, the x-axis and two ordinates. OR first-quadrant area bounded by a line, a semicircle and the x-axis.
template: Area enclosed by {curve}, the x-axis and x = {a}, x = {b}.

summary: Transmission wires along two given lines: decide whether they are coplanar and find their intersection point.
template: Lines {l1} and {l2}: (i) coplanar? (ii) point of intersection.

parts.label: (i)
parts.summary: Decide whether the two lines are coplanar, with reason.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.summary: Find where the two lines intersect.
